analyst: The script builds a volume profile over a configurable lookback window to locate the Point of Control (POC) band and measures the net delta (buying versus selling volume) at that price level. A trade opens when price breaks the POC channel in the direction of a delta imbalance that exceeds a minimum percentage threshold, confirmed over a set number of candles, while the EMA slope points in the same direction; the entry is further restricted to an overnight 18:00–08:00 ET session and a cooldown period after the previous trade. The stop is a fixed dollar amount (default $250) divided by the point value to get points, and an optional breakeven rule can shift the stop to entry plus a quarter-point once unrealized profit reaches a trigger level. Positions are force-closed the moment the session ends, and a trailing-stop option can tighten the stop incrementally as profit grows.
